title: GeometryUsage
description: Buffer reuse hint used by geometry-aware render paths. - `static` - not expected to be mutated after creation; the only usage a retained recording may reference, and the one eligible for shared batched buffers. - `dynamic` - occasionally mutated; re-uploaded after Geometry.invalidate. - `stream` - mutated every frame; resolved like `dynamic` today, kept as a statement of intent for a backend that specialises on it.

sections.title: Import
paragraphs: Buffer reuse hint used by geometry-aware render paths.

- `static` - not expected to be mutated after creation; the only usage a retained recording may reference, and the one eligible for shared batched buffers. - `dynamic` - occasionally mutated; re-uploaded after Geometry.invalidate. - `stream` - mutated every frame; resolved like `dynamic` today, kept as a statement of intent for a backend that specialises on it.
